[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Overview of Automated Workflow
  1. Manual Sample Loading
    • The run is initiated with a manual pause step to allow the operator to fill the sample loop ("Manually fill sample loop").
  2. ÄKTA Pure Chromatography Run
    • The ÄKTA Pure system executes the predefined protocol controlled by the automation workflow.
    • Online signals acquired during the run include UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond), sampled at a fixed interval of 1 second.
3.2 Run Parameters

The following placeholders capture the run parameters used during this ÄKTA chromatography experiment. Values will be filled automatically by the automation system:

Parameter Description Value (Placeholder)
Process ID Identifier of the automated chromatography process [[PROCESS_ID]]
Equilibration duration Total time for column equilibration before loading [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]]
Equilibration flow rate Flow rate used during equilibrating the column [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]]
Load/inject duration Time for sample loading / injection onto the column [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]]
Load/inject flow rate Flow rate during sample loading / injection [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]]
Elution gradient duration Total time for the elution gradient [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]]
Elution gradient start Starting composition of the elution gradient [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]]
Elution gradient end Final composition of the elution gradient [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]]
Wash duration Duration of post-run column wash [[WASH_DURATION]]
Wash flow rate Flow rate during column wash [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]]
CIP duration Overall time for column cleaning-in-place (CIP) [[CIP_DURATION]]
CIP step 2 hold duration Contact/hold time during CIP step 2 [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]]
CIP step 3 duration Duration of CIP step 3 [[CIP_3_DURATION]]
CIP step 4 duration Duration of CIP step 4 [[CIP_4_DURATION]]
CIP step 5 duration Duration of CIP step 5 [[CIP_5_DURATION]]

4. Results

4.1 Chromatogram
[[PLOT_1]]

Figure 1: Chromatogram of the ÄKTA run showing UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) traces over time. The corresponding image file (e.g. chromatogram_{ID}.png) is stored in eLabFTW and linked via its download URL.

4.2 Notes on Run Performance
  • Inspect the main elution peak(s) for peak shape and retention volume.
  • Review the conductivity profile to confirm correct buffer transitions and gradient execution.
  • Confirm that equilibration, wash, and CIP phases were executed according to the specified durations and flow rates in the parameter table above.
